final_message:
I fixed `transpose` in `src/matrix.py`. I haven't run it or any tests.

The bug was that it used the row count for both dimensions, so it only worked on square matrices. A 2×3 input would raise an `IndexError`, and a 3×2 input would silently drop a column. It now uses the row count and the column count separately, so any rectangular matrix transposes correctly. An empty matrix returns `[]`.
